say: Hi. I'm the voice inside Loudr.
Loudr already types what you say. Now, it talks back.
Select text in any app. Tap one key. Then just listen.
Or paste a script, pick a voice, and save it as an MP3.
It all runs on your computer. Nothing you select is sent anywhere.
Nine voices. No account. No limits.
Loudr. Free and open source, on GitHub.
